reuse.why: Introduces getBulkBudgetCategories and the averages, setZero and the new setLastMonthSpending use it, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline exclusion checks and setLastMonthSpending re-writes the income guard and sign flip used by the averages.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule (hidden / hidden group / saved template / #fixed group) exists twice, in getBulkBudgetCategories (SQL plus tag filter) and as field checks in copyPreviousMonth, and the income guard and expense sign inversion are copied again in setLastMonthSpending.

placement.why: The shared selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings; the rule is split between SQL and a JS post-filter.

scope.why: Stays within the budget actions and their registration and tests, with some unformatted reflowing of the getBudgetData type.

maintainability.why: Most actions now share one selection, but copyPreviousMonth must be kept in sync by hand and already diverges by ignoring includeHiddenCategories, so a future rule change is easy to miss there.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies hidden, group-hidden, #fixed and goal_def checks inline over getBudgetData instead of using getBulkBudgetCategories, and does not accept includeHiddenCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses getBulkBudgetCategories' exclusion rule as per-row JS checks (hidden/group_hidden, extractTagsFromText(group_notes), goal_def != null); setLastMonthSpending reshapes the sign inversion as a ternary.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories parameter, implemented as a `? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0)` toggle in its SQL; copyPreviousMonth bypasses the helper and re-implements the rule.
